title: Community garden plot application
brief: Build an original self-contained HTML application flow for a community garden plot: enter details, review answers, submit and confirm.
context: Required: full name and email. Optional: preferred plot name. Accept names such as Jo O’Neill. Show validation errors on Continue. The review page allows changing each answer and returning directly to review. This is a fictional cooperative service, not a government service.

user_facts.eligibility: No eligibility checks in this prototype

constraints: Do not use GOV.UK branding, crown imagery or official-service claims.
Missing optional plot preference must not block submission.

checks.criterion: Submitting empty required fields moves focus to an error summary with links that focus the corresponding inputs.
Enter Jo O’Neill and jo@example.test, continue, change only the email, and return directly to review with name retained.
The review page makes the unanswered optional preference understandable without implying an error.
GARDEN-204 confirmation appears only after an explicit final submission from review.
